question: Two bakers, Talia and Marcus, count muffin trays, but this story follows only Talia's trays, which started at 89 muffins, fewer than Marcus had baked. A big order left her with 6 times as many muffins. She then baked 7 more, and a helper added 27 more. A catering contract multiplied her total by 7. A nearby bakery priced its cupcakes at 3 dollars each, unrelated to Talia's count. How many muffins did Talia end up with?

A single lemonade stand cash box started the morning with 44 dollars. In the morning, 24 more dollars came in from early customers. In the afternoon, 28 dollars were spent restocking cups and lemons. Later that afternoon, 16 more dollars came in, after a rush that lasted about 30 minutes, roughly half an hour. That evening, 20 more dollars came in from a final wave of customers. How much money was in the cash box by the end of the evening?

A single food truck's ingredient count started the morning with 230 pounds of potatoes. By midmorning, a supplier delivery left the truck with 4 times as many pounds. In the afternoon, a tripling promo tripled that amount for a festival contract. Later that afternoon, 64 more pounds arrived from a farm co-op. That evening, a second matching contract multiplied the total by 3 once more. How many pounds of potatoes did the truck have by the end of the evening?

A single lemonade jar started the morning with 15 dollars in tip money. A busy morning left the jar with 7 times as much money. Then 39 more dollars were added from a bake sale table next to it. A matching donation multiplied the jar's total by 6. Finally, 25 more dollars came in from a raffle. A separate donation box nearby held about a dozen gift cards, unrelated to this jar's total. How much money was in that one jar in the end?

A single school's book fair cash box started the day with 100 dollars. It grew by 38 dollars from morning sales, then 20 more from a raffle table, and 36 more from a bake sale next door. A matching PTA donation then left the box with 5 times as much money. A district grant multiplied that total by 7. A separate fundraiser nearby raised about a dozen dollars in loose change, unrelated to this box. Finally, 4170 dollars were spent on new books for the library. How much money was left in the cash box?

Two neighbors, Wes and Fatima, keep track of firewood, but this story follows only Wes's woodpile, which started at 92 logs, fewer than Fatima's pile. He added 64 more logs from a delivery. He then split 29 more logs from a fallen tree. A cold snap used up 111 logs over a few days. A hardware store nearby sold axes for 45 dollars, unrelated to Wes's woodpile. Finally, 13 more logs arrived from a neighbor's extra stack. How many logs were in Wes's woodpile in the end?

A single charity's coin collection started the month with 150 dollars. The total was split evenly among 6 collection boxes, and this story follows just one box. That box then lost 14 dollars to a counting error. A matching sponsor multiplied that box's total by 9, after a fundraiser that lasted about 180 minutes, exactly 3 hours. A bank fee then cost the box 13 dollars. Finally, a year-end match multiplied the box's total by 4. A second nearby box held about a dozen dollars in loose coins, unrelated to this one. How much money was in that one box in the end?

A single food pantry shelf started the morning with 126 cans of beans. In the morning, 80 more cans arrived from a grocery donation. Later that morning, 6 more cans came from a school food drive. In the afternoon, 155 cans were given out to families in need. That evening, 6 more cans arrived from a neighbor's pantry cleanout, around the same time a volunteer mentioned a dozen people had helped that day, unrelated to the can count. How many cans were on that shelf by the end of the evening?

Two friends, Petra and Sam, keep separate coin jars, but this story follows only Petra's jar, which started at 13 dollars, less than Sam's jar held. She spent 2 dollars on stickers. A birthday gift added 57 dollars to her jar. She then spent 12 dollars on a book. Finally, she spent 9 more dollars on a movie ticket, around the same week her friend mentioned saving about a dozen bottle caps, unrelated to the money count. How much money was in Petra's jar in the end?

A snack cart had 47 granola bars at sunrise. In the morning, 40 bars were sold to early joggers. In the afternoon, 35 more bars were restocked from the delivery van. Later that afternoon, 37 bars were sold during a lunch rush. That evening, 48 more bars were added for a late event, around the same time a nearby cart sold bottled water for 2 dollars each, unrelated to the granola bar count. How many granola bars did the cart have by the end of the evening?

A single beekeeper's honey barrel started the morning with 72 liters. A strong harvest left the barrel with 4 times as much honey. A bottling run then used up 237 liters for jars. A leftover batch added 3 more liters back. A regional order multiplied the remaining honey by 7, after a bottling shift that ran about 240 minutes, exactly 4 hours. Finally, the honey was split evenly among 6 identical barrels, and this story follows just one barrel. How many liters of honey were in that one barrel?

Two shop owners, Elif and Bram, track their sock inventory, but this story follows only Elif's stock, which started at 186 pairs, more than Bram's stock. A bulk order left her with 3 times as many pairs. A supplier added 73 more pairs. A big sale then used up 591 pairs. A late shipment added 14 more pairs, and a final small delivery added 5 more, around the time a rival shop priced its socks at 6 dollars a pair, unrelated to Elif's count. How many pairs of socks did Elif have in the end?

A food truck had 56 pounds of shrimp in its cooler at sunrise. In the morning, 21 pounds were used for breakfast tacos. Later that morning, 18 more pounds arrived from a supplier. In the afternoon, 20 pounds were used for a lunch rush, and 28 more pounds were used for a catering order. That evening, a matching delivery left the truck with 2 times as much shrimp. How many pounds of shrimp did the truck have by the end of the evening?

A single charity's supply closet started the month with 211 blankets. A donation drive added 42 more blankets that week. A shelter delivery then used up 26 blankets. A large distribution used 120 more blankets, after a delivery run that took about 90 minutes, roughly an hour and a half. A storm relief effort then used 58 more blankets. A volunteer coordinator mentioned a dozen extra volunteers showed up that week, unrelated to the blanket count. Finally, 27 more blankets arrived from a textile donor. How many blankets were in that closet in the end?

Two managers, Deshawn and Priya, each run a warehouse of bottled water, but this story follows only Deshawn's stock, which started at 120 cases, more than Priya's warehouse held. A shipment removed 4 cases for damage. A retailer order then took 21 more cases. A large distribution used 53 more cases. A final small order took 9 more cases, around the time a nearby store priced water at 8 dollars a case, unrelated to this warehouse. Finally, a matching restock multiplied the remaining cases by 3. How many cases did Deshawn's warehouse have in the end?

A print shop had 88 posters ready at sunrise. In the morning, 39 posters were sold to a local band, and by midday a rush order left the shop needing 8 times as many posters. In the afternoon, 76 posters were pulled for a smudge defect, and a matching order then left the shop with 2 times as many posters. That evening, a citywide festival multiplied the posters by 7, around the time a rival shop charged 12 dollars a banner, unrelated to this count. Finally, 3230 posters were shipped out to a distributor. How many posters did the shop have left?

A food bank had 97 boxes of pasta at sunrise. In the morning, 16 boxes were given to a shelter. Later that morning, 72 more boxes were distributed to families. By afternoon, a matching donation left the pantry with 2 times as many boxes. That afternoon, a second matching donation multiplied the boxes by 3. That evening, 77 more boxes arrived from a grocery chain. How many boxes of pasta did the food bank have by the end of the evening?

A single toy warehouse started the month with 192 dolls in stock. A holiday order left the warehouse with 6 times as many dolls. A matching contract then tripled that count for a chain of stores. The dolls were then split evenly among 6 delivery trucks, and this story follows just one truck. That truck received 12 more dolls from a returned batch, and 16 more from a local donor, after a stop that took about 30 minutes, roughly half an hour. Finally, a bulk holiday order multiplied that truck's dolls by 9. How many dolls were on that truck in the end?

Two runners, Kofi and Ada, log training miles, but this story follows only Kofi's log, which started at 74 miles, fewer than Ada's log showed. He ran 65 more miles that week, then 41 more the next week, then 77 more after that, and 20 more the week after. A data sync error then erased 207 miles from his log. Finally, 18 more miles were added back after the error was fixed. How many miles did Kofi's log show in the end?

A single classroom's supply of markers started the morning with 222 markers in a bin. By midmorning, the markers were split evenly among 3 tables, and this story follows just one table. In the afternoon, that table lost 55 markers that dried out. Later that afternoon, a supply closet restock left the table with 3 times as many markers, after a delivery that took about 20 minutes, well under half an hour. That evening, 51 markers were sent to a neighboring classroom. How many markers were at that one table by the end of the evening?

A single food pantry started the month with 196 pounds of rice. A large distribution used 158 pounds for local families, and a grocery donation then added 66 more pounds. A school food drive used 73 more pounds, and a shelter delivery used 25 more, during a week volunteers logged about 120 minutes of sorting, right around 2 hours. A community garden then donated 73 more pounds, but 19 more pounds were sent to a neighboring pantry. A separate donation bin nearby collected about a dozen cans of soup, unrelated to the rice count. How many pounds of rice remained in the pantry?

A single library book cart started the morning with 168 books. In the morning, 47 more books were added from returns. By midday, a tripling donation tripled the cart's books for a book fair. In the afternoon, 245 books were sold at the fair. That afternoon, 50 more books arrived from a late donor. That evening, 36 more books were added from a school drop-off. How many books were on that cart by the end of the evening?

A beekeeper started spring with 34 jars of honey in the shed. A neighbor gave her 33 more jars from an old batch. A record bloom then left her with 9 times as many jars. A regional co-op multiplied that total by 5. A late harvest added 25 more jars, around the time the farmers market began charging 3 dollars for parking, unrelated to her honey count. Finally, a wholesale contract multiplied her jars by 7. How many jars of honey did she end up with?

A single charity thermometer started the morning at 139 dollars raised. By midmorning, a matching sponsor left the total at 7 times as much. In the afternoon, 35 more dollars came in from a bake sale. Later that afternoon, 78 more dollars arrived from a raffle, after an event that ran about 180 minutes, exactly 3 hours. That evening, 52 more dollars came in from a final walk-in donor. How much money had been raised by the end of the evening?

A single classroom's supply of crayons started the morning with 172 crayons in a bin. By midmorning, the crayons were split evenly among 4 tables, and this story follows just one table. In the afternoon, that table received 46 more crayons from a supply closet. Later that afternoon, 68 crayons were lost, and 10 more were broken. That evening, 55 more crayons arrived from a donation, and 47 more came from a second classroom's leftover box, around the time the school reported spending 9 dollars on new scissors, unrelated to this count. How many crayons were at that one table by the end of the evening?
